query: Find blue and white striped shirts under 2000 rupees
sql: SELECT parent_asin FROM shirts WHERE CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(color, '')) || '|', '|blue|') AND CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(color, '')) || '|', '|white|') AND pattern IN ('horizontal_stripes', 'vertical_stripes', 'diagonal_stripes') AND price_inr_est < 2000

query: Find maroon plain full sleeve shirts
sql: SELECT parent_asin FROM shirts WHERE CONTAINS('|' || LOWER(COALESCE(color, '')) || '|', '|maroon|') AND pattern IN ('plain') AND sleeve = 'full'
